## Checklist
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] No code was copied, translated or paraphrased from unlicensed or non-commercial projects ([clean-room policy](../docs/CLEAN-ROOM.md))
- [ ] Code adapted from Apache-2.0 / MIT / BSD sources keeps its header and is listed in `NOTICE`
- [ ] Docs / capability matrix updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No personal data in screenshots, traces or logs
